home.introduction: Elaina Theme is a Pengu Loader theme for the League Client. It changes the client visuals, adds custom assets, provides wallpaper/audio controls, and includes optional quality-of-life plugins.
features: Custom homepage wallpaper with image/video support.
Custom background audio with volume, loop, mute, and in-game pause controls.
Custom font, profile banner, avatar, border, currency icons, rank icons, rune backgrounds, and other client UI assets.
Interface toggles for transparency, hidden client sections, game tab visibility, profile layout, and nickname styling.
Optional plugins for queue automation, auto accept, loot helper, invite all friends, profile spoofing, custom status, custom BE/RP, and developer tools.
Manual JSON backup/restore and optional cloud backup/restore.
configurationModel: On Pengu Loader 1.2.0 and newer, ElainaData stores settings in `./data/ElainaData.json` through PluginFS when `context.fs` is available.
On older Pengu Loader builds, ElainaData falls back to Pengu DataStore under the `ElainaTheme` key.
The in-client settings are available from League Client Settings -> Elaina Theme.
Most visual toggles need a client reload or restart before every affected screen is fully refreshed.

installation.introduction: Use the instructions that match your Pengu Loader version. The theme supports both older DataStore-only Pengu builds and Pengu Loader 1.2.0+ builds with PluginFS.
requirements: League Client installed and able to launch normally.
An Elaina Theme release zip or a local build output from this repository.
A writable Pengu Loader plugins folder.

Do not move files out of the theme folder after installation; relative asset paths depend on that layout.

backupRestore.introduction: Backup/Restore lets you export settings to a local JSON file, restore from a JSON file, or use the theme cloud backup service.
storageModes: Pengu Loader before 1.2.0: settings are stored in Pengu DataStore under `ElainaTheme`.
Pengu Loader 1.2.0+: settings are stored through PluginFS in `./data/ElainaData.json` when `context.fs` is available.
Manual backup exports the current ElainaData values regardless of the active storage mode.
Cloud backup uses the current summoner ID and Elaina Theme API token.
manualBackup: Open League Client Settings -> Elaina Theme -> Backup & Restore.
Keep the JSON file somewhere safe before reinstalling or updating the theme.
manualRestore: Open League Client Settings -> Elaina Theme -> Backup & Restore.
Click Restore in the manual backup/restore section.
Select a valid JSON backup file.
Wait for the restore toast to complete.
The client restarts automatically after restore.
cloudBackup: The theme checks whether cloud data exists for your summoner ID.
When backup is enabled, the theme can write datastore values to the Elaina Theme cloud service.
Use manual backup as a fallback if the cloud service is unavailable.
cloudRestore: If cloud data exists, Restore and Delete file buttons become visible.
Click Restore to load cloud data into ElainaData.
Click Delete file to remove the cloud backup.
Restart the client after restore if a screen does not update immediately.
notes: Cloud backup requires internet access and the Elaina Theme API service to be available.
Developer mode may show extra system information in the backup panel.
Do not edit a backup JSON file unless you know the setting keys and value types.
If restore fails, check the console and try manual restore with a known valid JSON backup.

faq.introduction: Common problems and the quickest checks for each one.

items.question: The theme does not appear in League Client settings.
answer: Verify that the built theme folder is inside the Pengu Loader plugins directory.
Verify that Pengu Loader is running and enabled for the League Client.
Restart the League Client.
Check the console for theme import or syntax errors.

items.question: My wallpaper or audio file does not show up.
answer: For Pengu Loader 1.2.0+, verify the file is in the correct asset folder and has a supported extension.
For older Pengu builds, add the exact filename manually in Theme Settings -> Asset library.
Reload the client if the asset list was changed while the client was already open.
Avoid unsupported extensions or filenames that differ only by case.

items.question: Settings are not saving.
answer: On Pengu Loader 1.2.0+, check whether PluginFS can write `./data/ElainaData.json`.
On older Pengu builds, settings are stored in Pengu DataStore.
Try changing one simple setting, reload the client, and check whether it persists.
Export a manual backup before deleting or resetting data.

items.question: Auto Accept accepts too fast or accepts after I declined.
answer: Check `auto_accept_delay`; the value is in milliseconds and is capped by the plugin.
The current implementation cancels the pending accept when ReadyCheck ends or when your ready-check response becomes Declined.
If it still happens, disable Auto Accept button, reload the client, then re-enable it.

items.question: The client becomes slow after enabling wallpapers.
answer: Use smaller videos or image wallpapers.
Disable theme wallpaper or reduce video complexity.
Disable animated loading and other heavy visual replacements.
Reload the client after changing large assets.

items.question: Cloud backup says the server is unavailable.
answer: Check your internet connection.
Try again later; the cloud service may be sleeping or temporarily unavailable.
Use manual backup/restore when cloud backup is unavailable.

items.question: How do I reset the theme?
answer: Use the theme restore/default flow if available.
Export a manual backup first if you want to keep a copy.
On PluginFS builds, removing the theme data file resets file-backed settings.
On older builds, clearing the Pengu DataStore entry for `ElainaTheme` resets stored settings.

items.question: Should I enable Developer mode?
answer: Keep Developer mode disabled unless you are debugging or contributing to the theme.
Developer mode exposes debug tools and extra system information.
Some developer-only behavior can make the theme noisier or less stable for normal use.
